question: Do Ultimate-triggered ATK buffs affect a hit delivered at the cast timestamp?
decision: The descriptions trigger at cast rather than damage delivery. A successful Ultimate admission schedules buff activation in BuffTickOrExpiry, after resource costs and before same-time hits. This is an explicit timing hypothesis; native animation timing remains unresolved. Hit-triggered buffs and numeric energy callbacks keep their owning priorities.
stop_condition: Check native zero-delay and delayed hits, recipient-specific base ATK, independent stacking of weapon/set bonuses, refresh and equal-time expiry, failed admission and CLI/WASM/Worker parity.
return_condition: Native timing evidence shows activation after a particular first packet or a different per-weapon boundary.
checks: 126 ntesim-content tests pass; native same-cast and delayed Ultimate hits receive both 16% Good Boy and 15% Speedy Hedgehog bonuses before damage. Independent ATK/defense calculation checks different recipient bases, nonstacking refresh and exact expiry.
Actual native-build WASM checks compare the first Sakiri Ultimate packet against the 31% additive base-ATK oracle and reject both buff grants on failed admission.
web/tests/weapon_passives.test.mjs with NTESIM_VERIFY_NATIVE=1 compares full shared CLI/WASM reports for five Blast Candy refinements and a Sakiri/Zero team; actual Worker reports match direct WASM.
native_build, scenario_script and streaming_trials web modules pass; TypeScript, scoped pinned Rust formatting and changed web formatting pass.
Scoped content clippy passes with the two pre-existing metadata lints allowed; unqualified clippy remains blocked as recorded in blast-candy-model.json.
